title: A carried check's pending opening snapshot permanently invalidates its closing snapshot; source-capture refusal omits owner identity
outcome: Preserve pending opening provenance through a carried end, keep failed or differing captures fail-closed, and correlate source-capture refusal notices with their owner and run.
acceptance: RED-first deterministic regressions reproduce the confirmed source-capture completion/publication defect on the unchanged product and pass after its minimal fix. A capture still pending publication cannot be mistaken for a completed missing snapshot, and a check whose unchanged start and finish snapshots were successfully captured remains eligible without rerunning its producer.

Real capture failure, deadline expiry, source mismatch, mutation, overlap and owner/grant replacement remain fail-closed. Pending versus completed-None capture states stay distinguishable; no fabricated snapshot, endpoint-hash waiver, timeout inflation or automatic test retry is introduced.

Source-capture refusal notices identify the exact check, available run identity, source root and owning session and are delivered only to that owner after the applicable grant/claim revalidation. Deterministic tests cover two sessions and a stale/replaced owner; no command secrets are added to the notice.

The item records both reported occurrences, distinguishes the reproduced mechanism from any unproven historical cause, and delivers a frozen patch with focused capture/credit/notice regressions passing on that exact source and a fresh read-only Codex+Claude pair with no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding. Full landing gate and integration remain Merger's responsibility.
